task:
Finish the cachectl Go CLI in tools/cachectl/ (module github.com/erfianugrah/cachectl, stdlib ONLY, zero external deps). It replaces scripts/cachectl.sh - READ THAT SCRIPT FIRST, it is the exact semantic spec for the four subcommands (status/verify/probe/purge). Also read runner.go: the Runner interface is the test seam, all remote ops flow through it.

Current state: go.mod, main.go, runner.go, status.go, verify.go, probe.go are written. The build FAILS because main.go calls cmdPurge which does not exist yet, and there are no tests.

Do, in order:
1. Write tools/cachectl/purge.go implementing cmdPurge with the exact semantics of cmd_purge in scripts/cachectl.sh: validate the site arg ('all' or ^[a-z0-9-]+$, reject anything else with exit-2-style usage error), interactive y/N confirmation unless -y (read from stdin), 'all' = rm -rf <ctrRoot> + mkdir -p <ctrRoot> inside the container via edge.dockerExec, a named site = rm -rf <ctrRoot>/<site>, then restart the container via edge.ssh("docker restart <container>"), then print 'purged <target> + restarted <container> (nuts re-creates dirs at open)'. Use fmt.Errorf with %w for wrapped errors, repo Go style (section headers, camelCase).
2. verify.go contains a dead helper tmpfsTrapPresent that nothing calls - remove it (and any import left unused).
3. Write the test suite (one or more *_test.go files, white-box package main, stdlib testing only, table-driven with t.Run subtests). Cover: parseConfiguredDirs (tab-indented Caddyfile fixture, duplicates deduped, sorted, Dir outside ctrRoot ignored), parseCacheStatus (fwd=uri-miss;stored, hit;detail=NUTS, missing fields), shellQuote (embedded single quotes), parsePurgeArgs + the site-name validator, cmdVerify against a scripted fake Runner (all-PASS path returns 0, injected failure returns 1), cmdPurge against a scripted fake Runner (invalid site rejected; -y issues rm -rf + docker restart in the right order; 'all' issues rm -rf + mkdir). Capture command output via the edge.out io.Writer field.
4. Tests must be HERMETIC: no network, no ssh, no docker, no filesystem writes outside t.TempDir(). The loop sandbox masks ~/.ssh, so any test that really shells out to ssh will fail.
5. Make all sensors green: gofmt clean, go build, go vet, go test -race -count=1.

Constraints: stdlib only (go.mod must gain NO require lines). Do NOT modify scripts/cachectl.sh (it is the reference). Do NOT run the tool against the live edge (no ssh to nixos, ssh is masked in the sandbox). Do NOT weaken or delete sensor-facing behavior to force green. Do NOT git commit, git reset, or git checkout - leave the working tree dirty. Match the existing file style: package main, '// ─── Section ───' headers, fmt.Errorf("context: %w", err), early returns.
